hints.interview: The interview type defines what the AI evaluates. "Interview" covers career and competencies; "Assessment" focuses on technical knowledge.

hints.questions: Five questions usually suffice. Prefer questions about real situations ("tell me about a time when…") — they reveal more than definitions.

docs.gupyStep1Desc: Generate the token in the Gupy panel and paste it here. The test confirms access before saving.
docs.gupyStep2Desc: The interview fires when the candidate ENTERS the configured stage — not when they apply.
docs.gupyStep3Desc: Coploy sends the interview link and marks the candidate with the sent tag.
docs.gupyStep4Desc: On finish, the score becomes a tag and the full feedback becomes a comment on the candidate inside Gupy.
docs.gupyReq1: Gupy API token with read access to jobs and write access to candidates.
docs.gupyReq2: Registered webhooks (the button above does it for you).
docs.gupyReq3: The configured stage must exist with the same name on the jobs.
docs.gupyFaq1Q: I configured it but nothing fires.
docs.gupyFaq1A: Check the stage name matches Gupy exactly, accents included. Leaving it empty fires at any stage.
docs.gupyFaq2A: Coploy is idempotent per candidate and job — a resend only happens if the candidate returns to the stage.
docs.gupyFaq3Q: The tag did not show up.
docs.gupyFaq3A: Tags are applied at the END of the interview. If the candidate did not finish, only the sent tag exists.
docs.payloadHint: This is what your endpoint receives when an interview finishes.
docs.retryHint: Delivery failures are logged with status and response. Retry is manual so you never get duplicates unknowingly.
docs.authHint: Use the key in the x-api-key header. It identifies the company — treat it as a password.
docs.contractHint: The full contract is public and versioned — the same API our own ATS consumes.

Hello {{candidato}}! Your profile caught our attention for the {{vaga}} role.

The conversation is by video and you record it whenever you can, no scheduling. About 15 minutes, on your own time.

Dear {{candidato}},

{{empresa}} invites you to the interview stage for the {{vaga}} role. The interview is asynchronous, takes approximately 15 minutes, and may be completed at your convenience.

direct.subject: Almost there — finish your profile

Hi {{candidato}}, to move forward with your application for {{vaga}} we need a few details on your profile.

It takes less than two minutes.

Completing it helps us assess you properly — under two minutes.

To proceed with your application for the {{vaga}} role at {{empresa}}, please complete the pending information in your profile.
